request: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

actions.operation: Create a rectangular pocket/cut (opening) on the lower back face of the coffee machine body
actions.target: Lower back exterior face of the coffee machine housing/body
actions.relational_constraint: Opening located on the lower back area; positioned approximately so it is equally distanced from the bottom edge and the left/right side edges of the device (i.e., roughly centered in the lower-back region). Corners rounded (radius 1 cm).
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which surface is the 'back' of the machine, and what constitutes the 'lower back' region. Identify the bottom edge/plane and the left/right side edges/planes to measure the equal distances from. Confirm cut direction (normal to back face) and whether 3 cm depth is blind into the body or up to an internal face.

intention: Provide a draft location/opening for a power plug connection and the main ON/OFF switch on the back of the coffee machine.
